newsitem.title: USA: U.S. West Coast spot prods mixed in subdued talk.
newsitem.headline: U.S. West Coast spot prods mixed in subdued talk.

text.p: Spot refined product prices on the U.S. West Coast were mostly higher in subdued talk amid news Unocal restored a hydrocracking unit at its Wilmington refinery in the Los Angeles area, traders said.
Distillates prices were generally higher amid greater liquidity than in markets, where prices were lower.

"CARB diesel has been the most active in the last few days," said one trader who pegged prompt prices in Los Angeles about a cent higher at 78/79 cents a gallon. Also, a jet fuel deal in Los Angeles was rumored done at 63 cents a gallon -- about 1.50 cents higher than prices on Wednesday.
